title: Civic AI for Self-Governing Communities
description:
This talk is built from the questions you post and upvote in the Meerkat on this page. Audrey Tang, Taiwan's cyber ambassador and first digital minister, sorts them into six clusters: attentiveness, responsibility, competence, responsiveness, solidarity and symbiosis.

Each cluster gets a short take and a link to the next. Two questions run through the whole tour: What should stay private and what should anyone be able to verify? Are shared norms held in code or upheld by people? Votes choose the best question in every cluster. Every cluster gets its turn.
